title: The frozen confirmation run
compared: The class of the comments Gemma posted against two decision rules on elephant-1's answers: the product-or-test question asked in three orders plus the environment question, and the product-or-test question asked once plus the environment question.
sample: 128 public jobs with a confident label from a frontier model, most of them made with hindsight, none among the jobs the threshold was read from; some share a test and a build with jobs used for tuning. Plus 19 jobs of the internal instance as a side check. The rules and the pass rule were written down before the run.

rows.rule: three orders and the environment question

verdict: Both rules passed: 95 and 93 right of 128 against 66 for the posted comments, and 14 of 19 against 6 on the internal jobs. The cheaper two-question rule was proposed.
